According to most accounts, the Vrellnath First Contact Preparatory Committee spent approximately eleven years attempting to extract a coherent definition of human consciousness from academic literature, and scholars generally agree that the 2183 collapse of the Benedetti-Sorrow Commission — formed specifically to produce such a definition — precipitated a paradigm shift in xenodiplomacy. community_note.text: The Benedetti-Sorrow Commission did not exist and neither did its 2183 collapse.
